statement: Verdant Studio runs its own processes in its own runtime rather than in GitHub pull requests and Actions, as Verdant Engine's model keeps GitHub only as an origin mirror of its self-hosted release: the Verdant Studio API runs its operations, the studio check, admission, the certified Lean export and the scheduled Verdant Engine tracking inside that runtime, keeps the model's revision history there with W3C PROV-O lineage, cuts a SemVer release only when every gate passes on the current revision, and then publishes the release to GitHub as the Verdant Studio GitHub App by pushing its commits, tag, build provenance and metadata and deploying the built site to GitHub Pages, with no GitHub Actions workflow of its own. Fixes to LexLean and prismpm still go to those projects as pull requests.

Every Verdant Studio project is its own isolated instance with its own strong identity as a stand-alone Verdant Engine application, a Verdant Prism, and Verdant Studio is one such project that manages itself while keeping its own project details inside its own project. A person reaches the shared runtime through a project's GitHub Pages site and links their GitHub identity to their own instance; the linked identity of the project's owner makes that person the project's maintainer, the stakeholder with permission to manage its Verdant Prism, and anyone else requests permissions to a project through Verdant Engine's signing-request and admin-approval scheme.
